client: Safari, plain navigation to the models path of the configured base URL
path_to_endpoint: Tailscale; endpoint is private-network only (not publicly resolvable)
note: The endpoint enforces no authentication (confirmed by the coordinator from a Mac on the private network at 2026-10-08T06:40Z: unauthenticated GET /models and POST /chat/completions both returned 200). A browser cannot attach a bearer header, and there is nothing for it to prove, so only the unauthenticated request was made. Endpoint address, SSID, carrier and Tailscale node names are intentionally omitted.
observations: Both contexts returned the identical six-model list; owned_by values were ollama for five models and llamacpp for one.

Safari does not display the numeric HTTP status; 200 is inferred from the rendered JSON body. Collection times are from the coordinator session clock when the maintainer reported each result, accurate to about a minute.
The maintainer's configuration lists seven models; the endpoint serves six. The missing one is the IQ3_XXS GLM variant.
